articles.title: Fake staking site drains $8.5 million in XRP from dozens of investors promising easy yield
articles.snippet: Seoul police say the amount of the scam might rise to nearly $20 million. Two alleged scammers were detained and a third remains at-large.

articles.title: South Korea plans to tax crypto gains over $1,740 as political battle moves to parliament
articles.snippet: The country plans on taxing cryptocurrency gains from Jan. 1, 2027, signaling that it does not intend to postpone the measure for a fourth time.

articles.title: Fed holds rates steady, extending pause as markets await Kevin Warsh's policy roadmap
articles.snippet: For the first time in several years, markets were somewhat split on whether the U.S. central bank would hike rates.

articles.title: South Korea report proposes stablecoin rules before crypto law
articles.snippet: Policy report recommends interim licensing guidance, greater flexibility for stablecoin issuers and rules ahead of the Digital Asset Basic Act.

articles.title: Fake Flare Network Staking Site Drained $8.5M in XRP: Seoul Police
articles.snippet: The ring copied Flare Network and its FXRP token, and planted Wikipedia entries, blog posts and YouTube videos to look legitimate.
